description: The national athletics completeness sweep Package 06 never ran. Scope is nationally material spectator athletics venues that could plausibly reach 1,000+, not every local running track.

source_families.family: UK Athletics / British Athletics National Championships venue rotation

evidence.note: Fetched: confirms Alexander Stadium, Birmingham as 2025 outdoor host (2-3 Aug 2025), returning after 2019.
Fetched: confirms Manchester Regional Arena as 2024 host (29-30 June 2024); decathlon/heptathlon at Alexander Stadium, 10,000m at Parliament Hill, London.

source_families.notes: The three rotating national outdoor/indoor championship venues identified — Alexander Stadium, Manchester Regional Arena, and Utilita Arena Birmingham (2025 British Indoor Championships) — are all already held in EXISTING-ESTATE.txt as CONFIRMED_1000_PLUS. The britishathletics.org.uk primary announcement article surfaced by search ('venues-confirmed-for-national-championships-in-2024-and-2025') returned HTTP 404 on fetch; Wikipedia championship-year pages were fetched as corroborating sources instead. Parliament Hill, London (used for one event, the 10,000m) is a small local track with no permanent stand and was excluded as immaterial. No venue outside the existing estate was surfaced by this family.

evidence.note: Search result / listing confirms 2026 National Senior and U18 Championships (29-30 Aug 2026) at Aberdeen Sports Village.
Fetched: official venue page, outdoor Chris Anderson Stadium stand seats 500 spectators.
Confirms Scotstoun Stadium, Glasgow, has just had a new 400m athletics track laid as host of Athletics/Para Athletics at the 2026 Commonwealth Games.

source_families.notes: Scotland's national championships rotate across Grangemouth Stadium (already held, CAPACITY_UNVERIFIED_HIGH_VALUE_CANDIDATE), Scotstoun Stadium, Glasgow (already held under RUGBY_UNION_GROUND — now also nationally material for athletics as the 2026 Commonwealth Games track venue), and, newly for 2026, Aberdeen Sports Village for the Senior/U18 championships. Aberdeen Sports Village is not in EXISTING-ESTATE.txt; fetched directly and confirmed below threshold (500-seat stand). No other Scottish venue outside the existing estate was surfaced as plausibly reaching 1,000.

evidence.note: Fetched: capacity 4,953 (2,553 seated, 2,400 standing); home to Cardiff AAC and Welsh Athletics HQ.
Fetched: 8-lane 400m track, home club Wrexham Athletic Club; no spectator capacity figure given.

source_families.notes: The Welsh Athletics facility directory index (welshathletics.org/en/facility) is a client-side filter/search tool that returned no static venue list on fetch — a tool limitation, not evidence the directory is empty. The two facilities material to this package (Cardiff International Sports Stadium, already held in EXISTING-ESTATE.txt at 4,953; Queensway Stadium, a named target row) were reached via search and fetched individually. No other Welsh venue surfaced by any search as plausibly reaching 1,000 spectators.

source_families.family: Athletics Northern Ireland national track network

evidence.note: Confirms Antrim Forum's athletics track was renamed the Northern Ireland Centenary Stadium in 2020, closed for refurbishment in 2024, reopened with resurfaced 8-lane international-standard track.
Confirms Mary Peters Track, Belfast, as venue for the NI and Ulster Senior Track & Field Championships.

source_families.notes: Both national-level NI venues (Mary Peters Track, Antrim Forum) are already held in EXISTING-ESTATE.txt as ATHLETICS_STADIUM. Training-only venues identified in passing (Jordanstown University track, Girls'/Boys' Model running tracks) were not individually inspected — they are club/school training facilities, not plausible 1,000+ candidates, and are out of scope per the SHARED-BRIEF's scope-discipline instruction.

source_families.family: National Athletics League (NAL) club venue list — lower-bound completeness check

evidence.note: Fetched: full 24-venue list for NAL fixtures, restricted to TrackMark-accredited venues — Basingstoke, Bedford, Birmingham, Bournemouth, Bromley, Chelmsford, Crawley, Derby, Eton, Glasgow (Scotstoun), Kingston, Liverpool, Manchester (SportCity), Milton Keynes, Nottingham, Poole, Portsmouth, Reading, Stevenage, Swansea, Trafford, Woodford Green, Yeovil, York.

source_families.notes: This is the UK's principal top-flight domestic club athletics league, used as a lower-bound sweep. Members were diffed by name/city against EXISTING-ESTATE.txt / ATHLETICS-BASELINE.txt: Birmingham = Alexander Stadium (already held, CONFIRMED_1000_PLUS 18,000), Manchester (SportCity) = Manchester Regional Arena (already held, CONFIRMED_1000_PLUS 6,500), Glasgow = Scotstoun (already held, CONFIRMED_1000_PLUS). The remaining 21 member venues are club/first-division-level tracks and were NOT individually capacity-fetched — per the SHARED-BRIEF's scope-discipline instruction this class of venue ('hundreds of local-authority running tracks, almost all below 1,000') is the expected, bounded residual gap rather than something to walk venue-by-venue.

evidence.note: Confirms Scotstoun Stadium, Glasgow, as the new-track athletics/para-athletics venue for the 2026 Commonwealth Games.

Confirms the rebuilt Meadowbank Sports Centre, Edinburgh (reopened Nov 2022, two-time Commonwealth Games host 1970/1986) retains an athletics track but with capacity reduced to a 500-seat stand, down from a historic peak of 16,500.

source_families.notes: Every Commonwealth/Olympic athletics-legacy stadium checked (London Stadium/2012, Alexander Stadium/2022 CWG, Etihad Stadium & Manchester Regional Arena/2002 CWG, Principality Stadium (Cardiff Arms Park legacy, no longer athletics), Meadowbank Stadium/1970+1986 CWG, Scotstoun Stadium/2026 CWG) is already present in EXISTING-ESTATE.txt under some class — none is missing. Also checked and confirmed as an already-held venue under a different name: Barnet Copthall, historically England/Middlesex's national athletics stadium (opened 1964), now StoneX Stadium (Saracens RFC) — already held as 'StoneX Stadium' in EXISTING-ESTATE.txt, RUGBY_UNION_GROUND. Hampden Park, Glasgow (Scotland's national football stadium, temporarily converted for 2014 CWG athletics) was considered and excluded: it has no permanent athletics track today and is a football-identity venue already covered by the football sweep, out of this package's scope.

new_in_package_07.notes: Regional successor athletics facility to the closed Don Valley Stadium; home of City of Sheffield & Dearne AC (a National Athletics League club). Not present in EXISTING-ESTATE.txt. Two further pages that might have carried a capacity figure (shu.ac.uk/business/event-services/venues/city-athletics-stadium and an accessable.co.uk access guide) returned HTTP 404 and 403 respectively on fetch — a tool limit, not a negative finding. Not among the rotating UK Athletics national championship venues. Genuinely unresolved rather than confirmed either side of 1,000; not promoted to CONFIRMED_1000_PLUS absent a fetched capacity figure, per the ABSOLUTE RULES.
